name: model_op_flash_mla_sparse_fwd
description: Sparse MLA flash attention forward over a paged shared KV cache (FlagTree python/tutorials/tle/dsa/01-sparse-flash-attn-tle.py::sparse_attention, the DeepSeek-V3.2 sparse decode path). query [T, 128, 512] float16 in TND layout with query_rope [T, 128, 64]; key and value [num_pages, 128, 1, 512] as a PA_BSND paged cache with key_rope [num_pages, 128, 1, 64]; sparse_indices [T, 1, topk] int32 names the compressed KV positions each query token attends to; block_table [B, max_blocks] int32 maps logical to physical pages; actual_seq_lengths_query [B] int32 is cumulative query lengths and actual_seq_lengths_kv [B] int32 the per-request KV lengths. K is gathered at each sparse index (page = idx // 128 through block_table, offset = idx % 128) and concatenated with its rope part, V is gathered without rope, then each query token attends over its gathered set with scale_value and a single softmax. Returns out [T, 128, 512]. head_dim is fixed at 512, rope head dim at 64, KV heads at 1, and sparse_block_size at 1; only layout_query TND, layout_kv PA_BSND and sparse_mode 0 or 3 are covered. Inputs are not modified.
